links.comparator_used: Other prompt types without a reading-level instruction (e.g., default question prompt)
links.outcome: Readability indices (FKRE, GFI, FKGL, SMOG) of ChatGPT responses to cancer questions
links.quote: The 6th-grade prompt markedly improved readability over other strategies (ChatGPT-5: FKRE:64.92 ± 8.56, GFI:8.10 ± 1.13, FKGL:8.74 ± 1.73, SMOG:6.97 ± 1.26; ChatGPT-4o:65.44 ± 7.43, GFI:8.04 ± 1.48, FKGL:8.73 ± 1.80, SMOG:6.86 ± 1.53).

design_hint: reading-level constrained prompting (6th-grade prompt) and query aggregation
